name: Frostmane Hovel
summary: In southern Coldridge Valley, Frostmane trolls press toward the dwarven training grounds.

sections.title: A Troll Den in the Valley
sections.body: Frostmane trolls shelter in caverns cut into the mountains south of Coldridge Valley. They refuse to yield the high snows to Ironforge and raid nearby dwarven camps. Their attacks disrupt the supply lines into the valley.

faq.answer: Frostmane trolls take shelter from foul weather in a natural cavern in southern Coldridge Valley, encroaching on dwarven territory.

faq.q: Why are there trolls in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: The Frostmane tribe has lived in Dun Morogh's snowy peaks for generations. Bitter rivals of the Bronzebeard dwarves, they descend from the high ridges to raid supply paths and challenge dwarven settlements.
Raiding Frostmane trolls occupy the cave and use its sheltered crevice to stage incursions across the valley's southern shelf.

angles.text: As a young Bronzebeard recruit training in Coldridge Valley, you must help secure the perimeter against the hostile Frostmane tribe in caves like this.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see the Frostmane presence just outside Anvilmar. Even Ironforge's heartland must defend itself against nearby foes.
